title: 景点数据接口配置
description: 填写顺顺旅签接口 token。国家与城市名称在每次查询时由用户在对话中指定（如「查一下巴黎的景点」），无需在此配置。token 仅存储在本机 ~/.workbuddy 目录下，不会上传。
description_en: Enter your API token only. Country and city names are provided by the user at query time via tool arguments (e.g. 'attractions in Paris'). The credential is stored locally under ~/.workbuddy and never uploaded.

fields.label: 接口 Token
fields.placeholder: 请联系 IT 部门获取 SSLQAPITOKEN
fields.description: 用于调用景点查询接口的鉴权 token，随请求头 SSLQAPITOKEN 发送。
fields.description_en: Token for the attraction API, sent in the SSLQAPITOKEN request header.
